create_LavaCrossingEnv: create a LavaCrossingEnv instance with a 9x9 grid and one lava river to cross
create_SimpleCrossingEnv: create a SimpleCrossingEnv instance with a 9x9 grid and one wall obstacle to navigate
customize_CrossingEnv: create a CrossingEnv with custom size, number of crossings, and obstacle type like Wall or Lava
review_CrossingEnv_gen_grid: review the _gen_grid method in CrossingEnv to understand how rivers and openings are generated
register_CrossingEnv_variants: register a new CrossingEnv variant with a custom id and entry point using the register function
